summary: Byzantine variant that mints Silver to upgrade Varangian units at Varangian Arsenals. Early Varangian Guard in Feudal and free reinforcements from the Warcamp.

spikes.label: Early Varangian Guard
spikes.detail: Early Varangian Guards come in Feudal and hit very hard.
spikes.answer: Archers and towers; avoid melee fights.

spikes.label: Varangian upgrades
spikes.detail: Silver buys three tiers of Varangian upgrades.
spikes.answer: Hit them before the Silver upgrades stack up.
